articles.title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s First DLC Is Out Now, Honors A Real Soldier Who Sustained Gruesome Injuries
articles.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 released today, October 23, and the game's first DLC pack is available now. In keeping with Call of Duty tradition, the day-one DLC is a Call of Duty Endowment (CODE) pack, with proceeds going to Activision's charity that supports military veterans find new jobs after…
body: The CODE Valor Pack adds the real-life Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter to the game as a playable character.

Carpenter was in Marjah, Afghanistan, when, on November 21, 2010, he put himself in front of a grenade to help save the life of his fellow Marine, Nick Eufrazio. Carpenter sustained serious injuries from the grenade blast. He was unconscious for five weeks, had his teeth stripped from his mouth, and lost an eye. He sustained numerous other life-threatening injuries in the blast.

Carpenter underwent brain surgery to remove shrapnel from his head. He had about 40 other surgeries to addresses his injuries, which included a collapsed lung, fractured fingers, and one arm that broke in more than 30 places. He had multiple skin grafts and now has a prosthetic eye, a new jaw, and new teeth.

The Valor Pack includes the Relentless and Valor skins, along with new weapon blueprints, a combat knife, and a weapon charm, among other things. All proceeds from the $20 DLC bundles will go to the CODE charity.
points: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 released today, October 23, and the game's first DLC pack is available now.

articles.title: Ahead of GTA 6, PlayStation 5 Sales Were Up 22%, Likely Due To Wolverine
articles.summary: The latter part of 2026 has been packed with excellent games, all leading up to GTA 6 on November 19, so it's not surprising that PS5 sales have jumped over last month. PlayStation 5 sales have jumped by 22%, according to a report from Bloomberg, with data from Circana.
body: We reached out to Circana Senior Director and Video Game Industry Advisor Mat Piscatella for comment on these recent sales increases, and he told us that despite its middling reception, Wolverine drove quite a bit of hardware sales. "PS5's hardware boost was primarily driven by Marvel's Wolverine. NBA 2K27 and Grand Theft Auto VI also likely helped," he said. However, he added that "Xbox Series did not get a similar sales boost during the month."

When IGN reviewed Wolverine, we gave it a middling 6 out of 10, with reviewer Simon Cardy saying, "Marvel's Wolverine's slick and satisfying combat wears thin well before its conclusion, so much so that even its strong character work can't quite save it from being anything more than okay."

In the weeks that have followed the game's release, the community has also been mixed on the game, and Insomniac has had to respond by fixing some of the more hand-holdy mechanics, like adding a toggle for the ever-present scent trail that guides you to objectives. But, even early on, there were signs that Wolverine was selling.

articles.title: FemShep Voice Actor Jennifer Hale Speaks Out After Mass Effect 5 Trailer Leaks Online
articles.summary: Award-winning voice actor Jennifer Hale, best known for voicing the female version of Commander Shepard in the first three Mass Effect games, is speaking out after a leaked trailer for the sci-fi franchise’s next title was leaked online.
body: The Mass Effect community was hit hard this week by news that EA is closing down BioWare, the 30-year-old studio known for spearheading Western RPGs with series like Dragon Age, Mass Effect, Jade Empire, and others.

Rubbing salt in the wound, EA also revealed the next Mass Effect game (supposedly titled Mass Effect Universe) was canceled. This revelation hurt even more after staff who formerly worked on the project spoke out about it online, with one even leaking a full-length trailer for the game on Reddit. This trailer promised a game that would have been everything fans wanted and more — and it even caught the attention of FemShep herself.
Hale responded to a re-upload of the Mass Effect 5 trailer on X/Twitter, and it seems she’s just as hopeful as the rest of us that somehow, some way, the game will still get made.
“It's extraordinary,” she wrote. “I’m holding hope for magic to happen. This community and you incredible devs deserve that and more.”

articles.title: Xbox Reportedly Asked Netflix for $800 Million for 7-Year Movie and TV Exclusivity Deal
articles.summary: Details on the behind-the-scenes dealings between the two entertainment giants came from a Puck report. The site stated that Netflix, interested in pursuing movie and TV adaptations for some of Microsoft's biggest games, began its offer at $500 million.
body: Xbox reportedly asked Netflix for $800 million for a seven-year deal that would have given the streamer exclusive adaptations based on its games.

What exactly the deal would have yielded outside of the promise to exclusively-licensed Xbox titles for adaptations is unclear, but for Microsoft, it was worth a lot more than what Netflix was willing to offer. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma and her team countered the offer at a staggering $800 million. Following a round of shakeups at Netflix from last week, the deal is said to be completely off the table.

It's unclear what exactly led to the deal breaking down, though Puck suggested the exit of Bela Bajaria, who served as content chief until being fired recently, played a role. Now, the site said that Xbox is "pursuing smaller deals with more partners." Who those partners are is a mystery for now.

body: James Gunn and Peter Safran’s DCU is growing at a steady clip. In 2026 alone, we’ve seen new movies like Supergirl and Clayface and gotten a deep dive into all things Green Lantern with the Lanterns series. But for many DC fans, there are only two questions that need answering right now. First, is Adria Arjona actually playing Wonder Woman in 2027’s Man of Tomorrow? Second, where the heck is Batman?!?

We can’t help with the first question, but we can tackle the second. The Dark Knight remains elusive despite Clayface taking place in Gotham City. As we explored in our Clayface Ending Explained, don’t expect Batman to put in an appearance in this Batman-adjacent film. So what do we actually know about the DCU version of this iconic hero? Does Batman currently exist in the DCU? Here’s what we know so far.

Dantics says that Mass Effect Universe was set over 600 years after the Reaper War, and players would step into the boots of a customizable N7 agent. articles.title: WoW: Forever’s Divisive Layering Will See Major Improvements For Launch, Blizzard Says
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's layering system will receive some significant improvements for launch, according to a statement provided to GameSpot from Blizzard. Layering, for the uninitiated, is a behind-the-scenes system in WoW: Forever that essentially creates and runs new versions (or layers) of…
body: There are some pros to this system. It makes completing quests easier (since there's less competition for quests items and enemies) and the world far less crowded. It also helps performance, as anytime there are thousands of players in a concentrated area, like a capital city, the game can struggle to handle the load. Layering spreads those players out. It works wonders in modern WoW and has also been used to different degrees in various versions of WoW Classic in the past.

Unfortunately, there are also some huge downsides that have repeatedly surfaced over the course of the WoW: Forever beta. It doesn't take much searching on YouTube or Reddit to find countless instances of players complaining about layering. Leaving a group, crossing into a different zone, or traveling on a zeppelin or boat causes players to abruptly switch layers. The layering changes feel far more frequent and noticeable than in the past, ruining some of the charm that comes from having a persistent world filled with the same people.

articles.title: Esper locations in Final Fantasy Resonance
articles.summary: Final Fantasy Resonance 's Espers give Fina an extra edge in combat, or sometimes they're just convenient decoys to bait the enemy into attacking them and not your party. However you use them, Espers are definitely worth the MP it costs to summon them.
body: Below, we show you where to find Esper locations in Final Fantasy Resonance and explain how to recruit them.

Espers look like traditional Final Fantasy summons, but they behave differently. Fina is the only party member in Final Fantasy Resonance who can summon Espers, and there's an MP cost for each summon. They remain on the field until they act three times, but while all your support spells apply to them, you can't control them. The Esper will use a different action from their arsenal each turn and then end their time on the field with their strongest skill. You can't decide which skill your Esper uses or which enemy it targets.

Once the Esper vanishes, you can have Fina summon them again on her next turn and repeat the process until she doesn't have enough MP for the summon. MP is the only thing that matters. There's no charge meter or timer dictating how often you can bring an Esper out.
points: Final Fantasy Resonance 's Espers give Fina an extra edge in combat, or sometimes they're just convenient decoys to bait the enemy into attacking them and not your party.

articles.title: With Minecraft and Diablo shows already on the way, Netflix reportedly offered Xbox $500m for a bigger film and TV deal
articles.summary: A deal between Netflix and Xbox has supposedly fallen through because of one minor quibble: Netflix wanted to adapt the console maker's games for $500m, not $800m.
body: That's according to Puck News ' Matt Belloni, who reports that Netflix offered Xbox $500m to exclusively licence the company's games and turn them into streamable films or TV shows for the next seven years.

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma and the division's business affairs team then responded with an eye-watering counter offer, according to the report. Xbox supposedly asked the streamer for $800m to sign off on the same deal.

Former Netflix CCO Bela Bajaria reportedly approached the game publisher first, but the executive's departure and Xbox's expensive counter offer led to the deal falling apart. Netflix CFO Spence Neumann was apparently one of the streamer's top heads who thought the deal wasn't worth the $800m price tag.

It's unclear which games would've been included in the film and TV deal considering multiple Xbox brands are already on their way to screens both big and small. Amazon is working to adapt Wolfenstein into a live-action series and will soon debut the third season of its acclaimed Fallout show, for example, while Paramount is turning Call of Duty into a blockbuster movie.

articles.title: Mass Effect 5 Pitched as 'John Wick and James Bond' in Space, Report Says
articles.summary: More details keep emerging about Mass Effect: Universe, the planned fifth mainline entry in the Mass Effect franchise that BioWare was developing before EA closed the studio on Wednesday. EA laid off BioWare staff and canceled what fans have long called Mass Effect 5.
body: On Friday, YouTuber Dantics spilled the beans on what feedback he allegedly provided during Mass Effect: Universe 's development as part of a "Mass Effect Council." According to a subsequent Kotaku report citing an anonymous source, the details Dantics provided are accurate.

Mass Effect: Universe would have taken place over 600 years after the events of the original trilogy, which is not-so-coincidentally the same amount of time the trip from the Milky Way to the Andromeda galaxy took in Mass Effect: Andromeda. You'll recall that previous N7 Day hints teased a possible connection between the next Mass Effect and Andromeda, and the leaked details double down on that connection.

Instead of a large-scale war like in Mass Effect 3, Mass Effect: Universe would have been about a "galactic Cold War" between different factions. Humans, Krogans, and Batarians would be allied as a faction, Council races allied as another, and the Geth as a third power in the galaxy. Presumably the Council races mentioned are Turian, Salarian, and Asari — perhaps humanity broke off from the council at some point, as humanity gaining a Council seat is a large plot point of the original trilogy.
points: More details keep emerging about Mass Effect: Universe, the planned fifth mainline entry in the Mass Effect franchise that BioWare was developing before EA closed the studio on Wednesday.

articles.title: As devastating Xbox "reset" continues, Dishonored studio Arkane Lyon reportedly only has until November to find a new buyer before it's closed
articles.summary: After getting caught up in Xbox CEO Asha Sharma's devastating layoffs and cuts earlier this year, Arkane Lyon - the beloved immersive sim studio behind the likes of Dishonored and Deathloop - reportedly only has until November to find a buyer. If the search fails, it will be shut down.
body: Arkane Lyon was one of a number of first-party studios reportedly facing closure ahead of Xbox's massive "reset" in July. However, when the layoffs were officially announced - bringing confirmation that 3,200 Xbox employees will eventually lose their jobs as part of the sweeping restructuring - Microsoft revealed Psychonauts developer Double Fine, State of Decay studio Undead Labs, and South of Midnight developer Compulsion Games would go independent following negotiations.

Hellblade studio Ninja Theory is now likely to close after two acquisition deals fell through, only leaving the fate of Arkane Lyon - a studio Microsoft acquired in 2021 when it purchased ZeniMax - uncertain. At the time, Xbox said it was "beginning required consultation with its Works Council to review potential strategic options" regarding Arkane, but little has been heard since.

body: Not every Dragon Age adventure came on a disc or via Steam download. Journeys, a free Flash tactical RPG from EA2D and BioWare, let you lead a party of warriors, rogues, and mages through turn-based, hex-grid battles, from a darkspawn ambush to Orzammar and back into the Deep Roads to find a Grey Warden. While Chapters 2 and 3 of this game never arrived, preservation projects have resurfaced Chapter 1 so you can still play it on a PC through the Flashpoint archive. An apt fate for a Deep Roads game, if you ask me.

The aftermath sends him and Miranda Lawson after a plot against the Citadel Council, shortly before he joined Cerberus. Finishing the iPhone game got you a reward in Mass Effect 2. Unfortunately, this mobile game left the App Store in 2012, and it was iOS-only, so there’s no official way to play it today — which makes Jacob’s vacation possibly the rarest trip in the galaxy.

articles.title: Mass Effect crossover items have seemingly been removed from Battlefield 6 following EA's sudden closure of BioWare
articles.summary: After EA's sudden shutdown of developer BioWare, upcoming crossover items themed around Mass Effect appear to have been removed from Battlefield 6.
body: With N7 Day right around the corner - slated for the 7th of November, as per usual - series fans reckoned the items would serve to celebrate the series' annual tradition and perhaps herald more news of Mass Effect 5. Those hopes were short-lived, sadly - developer BioWare is no more and the next Mass Effect game has been cancelled.
Following the shock closure, all Mass Effect items have seemingly been scrubbed from Battlefield 6's menus. Players spotted their absence in no time and shared the news online.

Battlefield 6's recent Dead Space crossover event already invited lots of divided opinions, with some players upset that the widely loved horror series is stuck in limbo while EA uses it to feed its live-service machine. Perhaps pulling a similar trick with Mass Effect - by celebrating N7 Day despite the series' uncertain future - would've simply poured salt onto a freshly opened wound. Although, the cosmetics were seemingly finished and ready to go.
points: After EA's sudden shutdown of developer BioWare, upcoming crossover items themed around Mass Effect appear to have been removed from Battlefield 6.

videos.summary: Grand Theft Auto V legacy review by Luke Reilly. Reviewed on Xbox 360.
body: "Grand Theft Auto V was a game so preposterously future-proof upon its 2013 launch on Xbox 360 and PS3 that its subsequent ports to modern machines remain the benchmark for open-world action-driving games. At the conclusion of this GTA Legacy Review project I find myself too emotionally attached to the PS2 pair of Vice City and San Andreas to push past my adoration for the style and soundtracks of those period piece classics and place anything above them but, make no mistake, there are very few games I’ve played more than GTA V. Combining an enormous and extraordinarily detailed world, three compelling protagonists, a thrilling set of varied missions and heists, and the foundation for a world of multiplayer that is simply a whole separate discussion, GTA V is the peak of the series. At least for the next few weeks, that is."

videos.summary: The Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 was created in close collaboration with Medal of Honor recipient and U.S. Marine Corps veteran Kyle Carpenter.
body: Inspired by Kyle's act of valor and recovery journey, the pack brings elements of his story into the game through authentic details drawn from his military service, personal mantras, and experiences.
Every purchase makes a difference. 100% of Activision's net proceeds from the C.O.D.E. Valor Pack will be donated to the Call of Duty Endowment. Available now at www.callofduty.com/valor #CODEValor
